flagged.evidence: The current carrier says, “The smooth boundary collar of F gives c:K×[0,δ)→F with c(s,0)=s” (line 79), then uses that collar to construct the adapted tube. Its current deps list (lines 9–29) includes AC and AC⇒ACω, but not thm-collar-neighborhood-theorem; Facts [A1] only route countable choice to tubular-neighborhood and surface-normal-form suppliers. The published collar theorem states, “Assume ACω. Every smooth manifold with boundary has a smooth collar.” Full AC supplies that hypothesis, but this proof neither invokes the theorem nor constructs the collar. The current proof therefore uses an unlicensed premise; adding the collar supplier closes this short gap.
